div.div: رثْدَةٌ , (IAar, T, S, M, L,) or ↓ رِثْدٌ , (K,) or both, (TA,) A company, (IAar, S,) or a numerous company, (T, L,) of men, (IAar, T, S, M, L,) staying, or abiding, [in a place,] (IAar, T, S, M, L, K,) not journeying, or departing, (S,) when the rest of them journey, or depart; (T;) as also لِثْدَةٌ. (T, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
